claim: Patchline ships an end-to-end autonomous repair agent that opens, defends, and merges verified migration PRs. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the autonomous claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make autonomous-repair-agent-gate`.
